messages:
Aisha Patel: Hi team 11 Our little one arrived at 34w and is in the NICU. My paid parental leave runs through 2030-07-02. Given the NICU stay wemay need extra time. Does Redwood provide a company pay bridge/top-up for NICU stays? Also my laptop auto-collection is scheduled mid-July can that be deferred?

Renee (People Ops): Oh wow, congrats and sending support. :heartpulse: Yes, we have a NICU accommodation process. Short version: we can provision up to 6 weeks additional company-paid top-up for primary caregivers with documented NICU stays, subject to medical verification. Steps: submit the NICU note via HR secure form, complete consent for PHI storage, optionally file STD claim.

Renee (People Ops): Link: https://intra.redwood/hr/forms/leave-adjust (choose "NICU/premature birth"). Once docs are in, we triage same day and mark payroll.

Aisha Patel: Thanks, just uploaded physician note (ref: nicu-2030-1102). Discharge hopeful around 2030-07-10 but could shift.

Finance Bot: Noted receipt nicu-2030-1102. If People Ops approves before payroll cutoff 2030-07-05 we can include retro top-up in the 2030-07-08 run; otherwise next run. Top-up is gross-pay-neutral and taxed normally.

Omar (Eng Mgr): Aisha 11 the team will cover your project work. Proposal: Diego picks up oncall rotation for first 3 weeks, I'll reassign two sprint tickets to a contractor. Budget ok for up to 6 weeks contractor time.

Diego (SWE): I can take oncall weekdays. @Oncall Bot please swap me in. I'll add a short handover doc in the repo: /docs/handover/ashia-nicu.md

Oncall Bot: Oncall change queued: Diego -> weekdays (2030-07-11 to 2030-08-01). Please confirm runbook access.

Aisha Patel: Appreciate it. About equipment: my checkout says return by 2030-07-15. Would prefer to keep until two weeks after ramp. Can People Ops override asset auto-collection?

Renee (People Ops): Yes we can pause auto-collection while on approved leave. DM asset tag and we'll place a hold. Also confirm: do you want a phased ramp when you return? We offer flexible ramps (50% FTE up to 4 weeks or custom schedule).

Aisha Patel: Prefer 4 weeks 50% to ease back in and fewer meetings.

Renee (People Ops): Got it, will note 4-week 50% ramp. Important: company top-up covers paid leave only, not ramp; if you want partial support during ramp we can look at a temporary accommodation.

Legal Ops: Heads up re: job protection - if you want FMLA/CFRA protections we need a physician note that ties to medical necessity and dates. For NICU stays courts treat neonatal hospitalization differently in some jurisdictions  so well make sure paperwork explicitly requests job-protected leave if desired.

Aisha Patel: Im not sure about FMLA. Please advise next steps.

Renee (People Ops): Quick checklist for you: 1) confirm discharge estimate in the secure form; 2) sign PHI consent (link generated after upload); 3) decide if youll open an STD claim (helps with wage replacement); 4) DM asset tag for device hold. We'll handle approvals asap.

Aisha Patel: Consent signed, STD not sure yet  can you send the STD summary and deadline?

Renee (People Ops): STD summary: https://intra.redwood/hr/std-summary. Typically you have 30 days to file but earlier is better. If you elect STD, benefits team will coordinate with payroll to avoid dual-paying beyond policy.

Finance Bot: FYI payroll treatment: top-ups are reported per standard payroll, benefits deductions apply. Retro adjustments possible up to one run back only.

Omar (Eng Mgr): I'll post a condensed handover template in thread. Diego, make sure to flag any flaky infra items. Team, please don't escalate oncall to exec pager unless emergency.

Diego (SWE): Will do. Also added a small alert-suppression rule in staging to cut noise: `alert.rules: suppress(non-prod, <5m>)`.

Renee (People Ops): Action items for People Ops: approve provisional NICU top-up pending final medical review, place asset hold for tag `RDW-ASH-103`, create phased-return accommodation record (4w @50%), send STD guidance, coordinate FMLA/CFRA if requested.

Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone. Really grateful for the fast responses and the device hold.

Renee (People Ops): Case opened: PO-2030-112. We'll reach out within 24 hours for a quick 15-min check-in to confirm dates. Reach out 1:1 any time. :seedling:
